entities.createSql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` (`surah_number` INTEGER NOT NULL, `name_arabic` TEXT NOT NULL, `name_transliteration` TEXT NOT NULL, `name_english` TEXT NOT NULL, `ayah_count` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revelation_order` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revelation_type` TEXT NOT NULL, `start_page` INTEGER NOT NULL, `basmala` TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(`surah_number`))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` (`global_ayah_number` INTEGER NOT NULL, `surah_number` INTEGER NOT NULL, `ayah_number_in_surah` INTEGER NOT NULL, `juz_number` INTEGER NOT NULL, `page_number` INTEGER NOT NULL, `has_sajdah` INTEGER NOT NULL, `text_uthmani` TEXT NOT NULL, `text_search` TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`global_ayah_number`))

entities.createSql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS4(`text_search` TEXT NOT NULL, content=`ayahs`)
contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_ayahs_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `ayahs` BEGIN DELETE FROM `ayahs_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_ayahs_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `ayahs` BEGIN DELETE FROM `ayahs_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_ayahs_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `ayahs` BEGIN INSERT INTO `ayahs_fts`(`docid`, `text_search`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`text_search`); END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_ayahs_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `ayahs` BEGIN INSERT INTO `ayahs_fts`(`docid`, `text_search`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`text_search`); END
